tests.scope: generated TFRecords, mocked HEAD/GET, synthetic1000/30/30 numeric records, frozen final split contract; no actual test request, checksum, payload, model or GPU

checks: CLI description is inert and complete six100k cohort/paired audit/root release gate precedes test metadata reads, HTTP imports/requests or numeric arrays. Exact source/protocol/train-admission/cohort/audit and sourceURL bindings required.

HEAD metadata is obtained only after freeze; root pins actual generation,length,CRC before a single generation-qualified GET; identity encoding and no redirects; no invented SHA before acquired bytes.
Acquisition checks full length/CRC32C and computes SHA256, fsyncs publication, retains exact partial bytes/hash on failures; source generation mismatch cannot publish complete data.

Separate converter pins unchanged prepare_goop_official.convert_one and original reader; verifies full object/record CRC, EOF/hash, offsets, complete record coverage, exact decoded element bytes and source stability. All30/T401/type7/key/context expectations checked after preservation; no subset or repair.

Census verifies all1000/30/30 numeric file hashes and actual dtype/shape/C-element bytes; identity ignores source IDs and NPY headers; within/across-split duplicates are recorded and prevent candidate admission.

Every test context array receives bit-level census; canonicalNaN/zero expectations are frozen evaluator compatibility checks, not grounds for discarding or altering source values. Context omission follows pinned official parser/model semantics.

Outputs prepared_requires_root_review admission candidate only; in-memory structural check is explicit and cannot launch evaluation. Final preflight uses exact frozen split/evidence functions with current hash-bound root admission.
Failed/interrupted acquisition/conversion/census outputs retained; no model/checkpoint deserialization, inference, tuning, automatic retry or changes to frozen sources.
limits: The gate trusts root-bound complete-cohort audit and checkpoint identities; it does not itself reread six checkpoint tensor payloads.
Synthetic compatibility is not actual test acquisition/admission. Root must inspect actual publisher metadata and complete conversion/census receipts before evaluation.
Cutoff is checked at entry; root must enforce a bounded process lifetime and outer cutoff for long acquisition/census work.
Exact stored byte duplicate identity does not detect transformed or approximately duplicate physical trajectories.
